annotations.title: Get the regulated price of a French legal notice

description: Use this when the user asks how much a legal notice (annonce légale) costs for a formality in a French department: returns the exact regulated price excluding and including VAT, set by ministerial order and identical in every authorised newspaper of that department. Notices priced by the character need their text for an exact amount; without it the rate per character is returned. Do not use to compare newspapers or providers: the price is set by law and is the same everywhere.

department.description: French department code of the registered office: 75, 13, 2A, 974…

formality.description: Formality (form slug), e.g. transfert-siege-dans-departement, sas, dissolution-anticipee.

text.description: Full text of a notice priced by the character (optional).

name: get_legal_notice_price
title: Get the regulated price of a French legal notice
